label: FUJICHROME PROVIA 100F Professional [RDP III]
source: FUJIFILM Data Sheet, FUJICHROME PROVIA 100F Professional [RDP III], Ref. No. AF3-036E (EIGI-00.10-HB-5-4), curves traced from the PDF's per-colour raster chart images (characteristic, dye density) and vector paths (spectral sensitivity), page 6

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity as charted on the chart's own labelled axis (sensitivity = reciprocal of the exposure in J/cm2 required to produce density 1.0 above D-min)

dye_density.unit: spectral diffuse density, absolute as charted (separated-exposure dye curves, each charted with its peak at about 1.0)

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by FUJIFILM. Page 6 characteristic-curve and spectral-dye-density charts are embedded 1-bit CCITT scans (about 300 dpi), one image mask per printed colour (black grid and text, red, green, blue / yellow, magenta, cyan), so each curve was read from its own colour layer as the ink centroid of every pixel column (gaps in dashed lines linearly interpolated). Axes calibrated piecewise on the grid lines fitted in the black layer (each fitted as its own sloped line); the colour layers are placed up to 0.3 pt off the black layer in the PDF and were mapped through their own image rectangles. Spectral sensitivity is a vector chart (one coloured Bezier path per layer), read from the PDF's vector paths. Characteristic curves (section 18): exposure daylight 1/50 s, process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A). Curves resampled every 0.02 log H. The green (dash-dot) and blue (dashed) layers are printed only where they separate from the line beneath: both stop on the red curve (join offsets: r there D 1.858 (diff +0.036); r there D 3.004 (diff +0.014)). Beyond those points the chart shows a single line, so green and blue are continued with the red curve; the toe and mid-scale of G and B are therefore the red curve as charted, not separately measured values. Small scan-jitter reversals removed with a running minimum (largest change 0.0030 D). Spectral sensitivity (section 19): process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A), density 1.0 above D-min; y axis 'Sensitivity* (log)' with ticks -1.0, 0.0, 1.0, values recorded on that axis as charted. Spectral dye density (section 21): exposure 'Separated Light', process E-6/CR-56; separate yellow, magenta and cyan curves recorded. rms_granularity is the single printed Diffuse RMS Granularity Value (section 16: 8; 48 um aperture, sample density 1.0 above minimum density); no granularity curve is published. No reference exposure, 18% grey aim or normal-exposure mark is given anywhere in the data sheet, so no log_h_ref is recorded and x stays absolute log H. No mid-scale neutral or minimum-density spectral curve is published. Not recorded (no field in this schema): MTF curve (section 20), resolving power (60 lines/mm at 1.6:1, 140 lines/mm at 1000:1). viewing D50: the data sheet (section 10) asks for an ISO viewer (ISO/DP3664-2), CIE illuminant D50, 5000 K.

scan.note: fitted to 98 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871937661-fuji-provia-100f-35mm/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
